doc:
A `Basis ι R M` for a module `M` is the type of `ι`-indexed `R`-bases of `M`.

The basis vectors are available as `DFunLike.coe (b : Basis ι R M) : ι → M`.
To turn a linear independent family of vectors spanning `M` into a basis, use `Basis.mk`.
They are internally represented as linear equivs `M ≃ₗ[R] (ι →₀ R)`,
available as `Basis.repr`.
statement:
Type u_1 →
  (R : Type u_3) →
    (M : Type u_4) → [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → Type (max (max u_1 u_3) u_4)

doc: `Basis.ofRepr` constructs a basis given an assignment of coordinates to each vector.
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_3} →
    {M : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → (M ≃ₗ[R] ι →₀ R) → Module.Basis ι R M

doc:
`repr` is the linear equivalence sending a vector `x` to its coordinates:
the `c`s such that `x = ∑ i, c i`.
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_3} →
    {M : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → Module.Basis ι R M → M ≃ₗ[R] ι →₀ R

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M],
  Function.Injective Module.Basis.repr

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (e : M ≃ₗ[R] ι →₀ R), ⇑{ repr := e } = fun i => e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [Nontrivial R], Function.Injective ⇑b

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι), b.repr.symm (Finsupp.single i 1) = b i

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (c : R), b.repr.symm (Finsupp.single i c) = c • b i

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι), b.repr (b i) = Finsupp.single i 1

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i j : ι) [inst_3 : Decidable (i = j)], (b.repr (b i)) j = if i = j then 1 else 0

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (v : ι →₀ R), b.repr.symm v = (Finsupp.linearCombination R ⇑b) v

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M), ↑b.repr.symm = Finsupp.linearCombination R ⇑b

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (v : ι →₀ R), b.repr ((Finsupp.linearCombination R ⇑b) v) = v

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : M), (Finsupp.linearCombination R ⇑b) (b.repr x) = x

  [inst_2 : Module R M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M'),
  (b.map f).repr = f.symm ≪≫ₗ b.repr

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {M' : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M')
  (i : ι), (b.map f) i = f (b i)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {M' : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M'),
  ⇑(b.map f) = ⇑f ∘ ⇑b

doc: `b.reindex (e : ι ≃ ι')` is a basis indexed by `ι'`
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {ι' : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} →
      {M : Type u_4} →
        [inst : Semiring R] →
          [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → Module.Basis ι R M → ι ≃ ι' → Module.Basis ι' R M

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ι' : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (e : ι ≃ ι') (i' : ι'), (b.reindex e) i' = b (e.symm i')

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ι' : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (e : ι ≃ ι'), ⇑(b.reindex e) = ⇑b ∘ ⇑e.symm

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ι' : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : M) (e : ι ≃ ι') (i' : ι'),
  ((b.reindex e).repr x) i' = (b.repr x) (e.symm i')

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ι' : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : M) (e : ι ≃ ι'),
  (b.reindex e).repr x = Finsupp.equivMapDomain e (b.repr x)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M), b.reindex (Equiv.refl ι) = b

        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → [Finite ι] → Module.Basis ι R M → M ≃ₗ[R] ι → R

doc: A module over a finite ring that admits a finite basis is finite.

{ι : Type u_1} →

      [inst : Semiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι R M → [Fintype R] → Fintype M

doc:
Given a basis `v` indexed by `ι`, the canonical linear equivalence between `ι → R` and `M` maps
a function `x : ι → R` to the linear combination `∑_i x i • v i`.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : ι → R), b.equivFun.symm x = ∑ i, x i • b i

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (u : M), b.equivFun u = ⇑(b.repr u)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} {M' : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M'] [inst_5 : Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
  (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M'), (b.map f).equivFun = f.symm ≪≫ₗ b.equivFun

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (u : M), ∑ i, b.equivFun u i • b i = u

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (u : M), ∑ i, (b.repr u) i • b i = u

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i j : ι),
  b.equivFun (b i) j = if i = j then 1 else 0

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : ι → R), ⇑(b.repr (∑ i, c i • b i)) = c

doc:
Define a basis by mapping each vector `x : M` to its coordinates `e x : ι → R`,
as long as `ι` is finite.
statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_3} →
    {M : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → [Finite ι] → (M ≃ₗ[R] ι → R) → Module.Basis ι R M

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] ι → R) (x : M) (i : ι), ((Module.Basis.ofEquivFun e).repr x) i = e x i

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] ι → R),
  ⇑(Module.Basis.ofEquivFun e) = fun i => e.symm (Pi.single i 1)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] (v : Module.Basis ι R M), Module.Basis.ofEquivFun v.equivFun = v

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] ι → R), (Module.Basis.ofEquivFun e).equivFun = e

doc: Two linear maps are equal if they are equal on basis vectors.

  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {R₁ : Type u_10} [inst_3 : Semiring R₁] {σ : R →+* R₁} {σ' : R₁ →+* R}

doc: Two elements are equal iff their coordinates are equal.
statement:

  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {x y : M}, x = y ↔ ∀ (i : ι), (b.repr x) i = (b.repr y) i

doc:
**Alias** of the reverse direction of `Module.Basis.ext_elem_iff`.

Two elements are equal iff their coordinates are equal.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {x y : M}, (∀ (i : ι), (b.repr x) i = (b.repr y) i) → x = y

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {f : M →ₗ[R] ι →₀ R}, ↑b.repr = f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), f (b i) = Finsupp.single i 1

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {f : M ≃ₗ[R] ι →₀ R}, b.repr = f ↔ ∀ (i : ι), f (b i) = Finsupp.single i 1

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {x : M} {i : ι}, b i = x ↔ b.repr x = Finsupp.single i 1

doc: An unbundled version of `repr_eq_iff`
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : M → ι → R),
  (∀ (x y : M), f (x + y) = f x + f y) →
    (∀ (c : R) (x : M), f (c • x) = c • f x) →
      (∀ (i : ι), f (b i) = ⇑(Finsupp.single i 1)) → ∀ (x : M) (i : ι), (b.repr x) i = f x i

doc: Two bases are equal if they assign the same coordinates.
statement:

  {b₁ b₂ : Module.Basis ι R M}, (∀ (x : M) (i : ι), (b₁.repr x) i = (b₂.repr x) i) → b₁ = b₂

doc: Two bases are equal if their basis vectors are the same.
statement:

  {b₁ b₂ : Module.Basis ι R M}, (∀ (i : ι), b₁ i = b₂ i) → b₁ = b₂

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {b₁ b₂ : Module.Basis ι R M}, b₁ = b₂ ↔ ∀ (i : ι), b₁ i = b₂ i

doc:
If `R` and `R'` are isomorphic rings that act identically on a module `M`,
then a basis for `M` as `R`-module is also a basis for `M` as `R'`-module.

See also `Basis.algebraMapCoeffs` for the case where `f` is equal to `algebraMap`.
statement:
{ι : Type u_7} →
  {R : Type u_8} →
    {M : Type u_9} →
      [inst : Semiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] →
          [inst_2 : Module R M] →
            Module.Basis ι R M →
              {R' : Type u_10} →
                [inst_3 : Semiring R'] →
                  [inst_4 : Module R' M] → (f : R ≃+* R') → (∀ (c : R) (x : M), f c • x = c • x) → Module.Basis ι R' M

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {R' : Type u_10} [inst_3 : Semiring R'] [inst_4 : Module R' M] (f : R ≃+* R')
  (h : ∀ (c : R) (x : M), f c • x = c • x),
  (b.mapCoeffs f h).repr =
    LinearEquiv.restrictScalars R' b.repr ≪≫ₗ Finsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv (Module.compHom.toLinearEquiv f.symm).symm

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {R' : Type u_10} [inst_3 : Semiring R'] [inst_4 : Module R' M] (f : R ≃+* R')
  (h : ∀ (c : R) (x : M), f c • x = c • x) (i : ι), (b.mapCoeffs f h) i = b i

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {R' : Type u_10} [inst_3 : Semiring R'] [inst_4 : Module R' M] (f : R ≃+* R')
  (h : ∀ (c : R) (x : M), f c • x = c • x), ⇑(b.mapCoeffs f h) = ⇑b

doc: `b.reindexRange` is a basis indexed by `range b`, the basis vectors themselves.
statement:
{ι : Type u_7} →
  {R : Type u_8} →
    {M : Type u_9} →
      [inst : Semiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] →
          [inst_2 : Module R M] → (b : Module.Basis ι R M) → Module.Basis (↑(Set.range ⇑b)) R M

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (h : optParam (b i ∈ Set.range ⇑b) ⋯), b.reindexRange ⟨b i, h⟩ = b i

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι), b.reindexRange.repr (b i) = Finsupp.single ⟨b i, ⋯⟩ 1

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : ↑(Set.range ⇑b)), b.reindexRange x = ↑x

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : M) {bi : M} {i : ι} (h : b i = bi), (b.reindexRange.repr x) ⟨bi, ⋯⟩ = (b.repr x) i

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : M) (i : ι) (h : optParam (b i ∈ Set.range ⇑b) ⋯),
  (b.reindexRange.repr x) ⟨b i, h⟩ = (b.repr x) i

  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq M] (i : ι),
  b.reindexFinsetRange.repr (b i) = Finsupp.single ⟨b i, ⋯⟩ 1

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq M] (x : M) (i : ι)
  (h : optParam (b i ∈ Finset.image (⇑b) Finset.univ) ⋯), (b.reindexFinsetRange.repr x) ⟨b i, h⟩ = (b.repr x) i

doc:
Construct a linear map given the value at the basis, called `Basis.constr b S f` where `b` is
a basis, `f` is the value of the linear map over the elements of the basis, and `S` is an
extra semiring (typically `S = R` or `S = ℕ`).

This definition is parameterized over an extra `Semiring S`,
such that `SMulCommClass R S M'` holds.
If `R` is commutative, you can set `S := R`; if `R` is not commutative,
you can recover an `AddEquiv` by setting `S := ℕ`.
See library note [bundled maps over different rings].
statement:
{M' : Type u_5} →
  [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] →
    {ι : Type u_7} →
      {R : Type u_8} →
        {M : Type u_9} →
          [inst_1 : Semiring R] →
            [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] →
              [inst_3 : Module R M] →
                Module.Basis ι R M →
                  [inst_4 : Module R M'] →
                    (S : Type u_10) →
                      [inst_5 : Semiring S] →
                        [inst_6 : Module S M'] → [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] → (ι → M') ≃ₗ[S] M →ₗ[R] M'

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] (f : ι → M'),
  (b.constr S) f = Finsupp.linearCombination R id ∘ₗ Finsupp.lmapDomain R R f ∘ₗ ↑b.repr

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] (f : ι → M') (x : M),
  ((b.constr S) f) x = (b.repr x).sum fun b a => a • f b

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (i : ι),
  (b.constr S).symm f i = f (b i)

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] (f : ι → M') (i : ι),
  ((b.constr S) f) (b i) = f i

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] {g : ι → M'} {f : M →ₗ[R] M'},
  (∀ (i : ι), g i = f (b i)) → (b.constr S) g = f

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M'),
  ((b.constr S) fun i => f (b i)) = f

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] {f : ι → M'},
  ((b.constr S) f).range = Submodule.span R (Set.range f)

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_10)
  [inst_5 : Semiring S] [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] (f : M' →ₗ[R] M') (v : ι → M'),
  (b.constr S) (⇑f ∘ v) = f ∘ₗ (b.constr S) v

∀ {M' : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst_1 : Semiring R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (S : Type u_11) [inst_5 : Semiring S]
  [inst_6 : Module S M'] [inst_7 : SMulCommClass R S M'] [inst_8 : Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : ι → M')
  (x : M), ((b.constr S) f) x = ∑ i, b.equivFun x i • f i

doc:
If `b` is a basis for `M` and `b'` a basis for `M'`, and the index types are equivalent,
`b.equiv b' e` is a linear equivalence `M ≃ₗ[R] M'`, mapping `b i` to `b' (e i)`.
statement:
{ι' : Type u_2} →
  {M' : Type u_5} →
    [inst : AddCommMonoid M'] →
      {ι : Type u_7} →
        {R : Type u_8} →
          {M : Type u_9} →
            [inst_1 : Semiring R] →
              [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] →
                [inst_3 : Module R M] →
                  Module.Basis ι R M → [inst_4 : Module R M'] → Module.Basis ι' R M' → ι ≃ ι' → M ≃ₗ[R] M'

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M), b.equiv b (Equiv.refl ι) = LinearEquiv.refl R M

doc:
If `b` is a basis for `M` and `b'` a basis for `M'`,
and `f`, `g` form a bijection between the basis vectors,
`b.equiv' b' f g hf hg hgf hfg` is a linear equivalence `M ≃ₗ[R] M'`, mapping `b i` to `f (b i)`.
statement:
{ι' : Type u_2} →
  {ι : Type u_7} →
    {R : Type u_11} →
      {M : Type u_12} →
        {M' : Type u_13} →
          [inst : CommSemiring R] →
            [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] →
              [inst_2 : Module R M] →
                [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] →
                  [inst_4 : Module R M'] →
                    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) →
                      (b' : Module.Basis ι' R M') →
                        [SMulCommClass R R M'] →
                          (f : M → M') →
                            (g : M' → M) →
                              (∀ (i : ι), f (b i) ∈ Set.range ⇑b') →
                                (∀ (i : ι'), g (b' i) ∈ Set.range ⇑b) →
                                  (∀ (i : ι), g (f (b i)) = b i) → (∀ (i : ι'), f (g (b' i)) = b' i) → M ≃ₗ[R] M'

∀ {ι' : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_11} {M : Type u_12} {M' : Type u_13} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M']
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (b' : Module.Basis ι' R M') [inst_5 : SMulCommClass R R M'] (f : M → M') (g : M' → M)
  (hf : ∀ (i : ι), f (b i) ∈ Set.range ⇑b') (hg : ∀ (i : ι'), g (b' i) ∈ Set.range ⇑b)
  (hgf : ∀ (i : ι), g (f (b i)) = b i) (hfg : ∀ (i : ι'), f (g (b' i)) = b' i) (i : ι),
  (b.equiv' b' f g hf hg hgf hfg) (b i) = f (b i)

∀ {ι' : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_11} {M : Type u_12} {M' : Type u_13} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_4 : Module R M']
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (b' : Module.Basis ι' R M') [inst_5 : SMulCommClass R R M'] (f : M → M') (g : M' → M)
  (hf : ∀ (i : ι), f (b i) ∈ Set.range ⇑b') (hg : ∀ (i : ι'), g (b' i) ∈ Set.range ⇑b)
  (hgf : ∀ (i : ι), g (f (b i)) = b i) (hfg : ∀ (i : ι'), f (g (b' i)) = b' i) (i : ι'),
  (b.equiv' b' f g hf hg hgf hfg).symm (b' i) = g (b' i)

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_11} {M : Type u_12} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {ι' : Type u_14} [inst_3 : Fintype ι'] (b' : Module.Basis ι' R M)
  (x : M) (i : ι), ∑ j, (b.repr (b' j)) i * (b'.repr x) j = (b.repr x) i

doc:
`b.coord i` is the linear function giving the `i`-th coordinate of a vector
with respect to the basis `b`.

`b.coord i` is an element of the dual space. In particular, for
finite-dimensional spaces it is the `ι`th basis vector of the dual space.
statement:
{ι : Type u_7} →
  {R : Type u_8} →
    {M : Type u_9} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → Module.Basis ι R M → ι → M →ₗ[R] R

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (x : M), (b.coord i) x = (b.repr x) i

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {x : M}, (∀ (i : ι), (b.coord i) x = 0) ↔ x = 0

doc: The sum of the coordinates of an element `m : M` with respect to a basis.
statement:
{ι : Type u_7} →
  {R : Type u_8} →
    {M : Type u_9} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → Module.Basis ι R M → M →ₗ[R] R

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M), ⇑b.sumCoords = fun m => (b.repr m).sum fun x => id

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) [inst_3 : Fintype ι], ⇑b.sumCoords = ⇑(∑ i, b.coord i)

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι), b.sumCoords (b i) = 1

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (m : M) (r : R), r ∣ (b.coord i) (r • m)

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (f : ι →₀ R), (b.coord i) (b.repr.symm f) = f i

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (b : Module.Basis ι R M), ⇑b.sumCoords = fun m => ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (b.coord i) m

∀ {ι' : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (e : ι ≃ ι'), (b.reindex e).sumCoords = b.sumCoords

∀ {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (f : ι → R), (b.coord i) (b.equivFun.symm f) = f i
